messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: P0 - Model serving error spike for model 'redwood-v2-optimized' (release rollout). 500s and malformed tokens observed in canary region. Automatic canary pause attempted. See /incidents/2361234567 for details.
elaine: acked. I'm oncall for infra. Pulling logs.
raj: on it - was on the release. We shipped a hotpatch to weights namespace earlier (hotpatch:weights/2026-03-15-heatmap). Might be related.
dana: seeing elevated 500s on canary (eu-west-1) starting ~2361234500. Error payload shows tokenizer failures: \"unknown token id -1\" and span misalignment in decode.
elaine: is canary traffic still routed? deploy-bot: Canary routing already paused at 2361234520 (automated).
raj: here's the live canary log snippet: ```ERROR Tokenizer: decode failed: TokenId(-1) at pos 12
ModelRunner: kv-cache mismatch for shard-3
Perf: latency p95 420ms -> 880ms
```
taylor: any config drift between tokenizer config and weightset?
raj: we updated tokenizer config in prod configstore yesterday to v2.1 but the weight hotpatch referenced weightset built against tokenizer v2.0. Possible mismatch.
dana: can we run a quick sanity check against canary model binary? command: ```curl -s -X POST https://canary.redwood.internal/generate -d '{"input":"hello"}' -H 'x-model: redwood-v2-optimized:hotpatch-2026-03-15'```
elaine: ran it -> returned garbled output and 500s intermittently. Sample: ```{\"error\":\"decode error: invalid token sequence\"}```
raj: confirmed. The hotpatch weight bundle was uploaded under the wrong namespace tag (weights/production vs weights/internal-hotpatch) and our rollout policy bound the canary to the production alias. That meant a weight binary built for an older tokenizer was served.
.deploy-bot: Rollout action: POST /api/v1/rollouts/pause canary=true by deploy-bot
elaine: next steps - kill flag to stop all rollouts and fallback to previous stable model variant. I will flip the feature flag and trigger rollback.
dana: +1. Also start mitigation play: route traffic to fallback model variant (redwood-v2-stable) and enable full request-level tracing for the affected customer paths.
raj: rollback command (dry-run): ```POST /internal/servectl/rollforward -d '{"target":"redwood-v2-stable","force":true}'```
elaine: executing rollback now. ```/internal/ops rollback --model redwood-v2-stable --force --reason "hotpatch wrong namespace/tokenizer mismatch"```
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated at 2361234820 by elaine. Canary drains and new routing to redwood-v2-stable in progress.
taylor: monitoring metrics: 5xxs starting to decline in eu-west-1. p95 latency heading down.
support-team: starting customer impact assessment - flagged 3 clients with elevated error rates. Opening incident bridge and notifying account owners.
raj: we should also revoke the hotpatch weightset alias to avoid accidental traffic rebind. Command: ```kubectl -n weights delete alias hotpatch-2026-03-15 || true```
dana: alias revoked. Confirmed no active references.
elaine: kill-switch flip complete: feature flag "auto_rollout_new_weights" = OFF at 2361234880.
raj: double-checking model metadata and tokenizer versions: ```Model: redwood-v2-optimized
weights: hotpatch-2026-03-15 (wrong)
tokenizer-config: v2.1 (prod)
expected tokenizer: v2.0 (weights)```
taylor: we need a post-fix step: add a pre-rollout compatibility check that validates tokenizer hash against weights manifest. Filing a ticket.
elaine: current customer impact: transient 500s for ~15 minutes for a small percentage (~0.7%) of requests in canary region. No broad production outage.
support-team: notified customers at 2361234960: "We detected and mitigated a deployment issue affecting text generation for a small subset of requests in eu-west-1. Traffic has been routed to a stable model variant and errors have subsided. We'll follow up with root cause and mitigation."
raj: root cause summary so far: mis-scoped hotpatch upload (wrong alias/namespace) + config drift (prod tokenizer updated earlier) -> incompatible weights/tokenizer pairing during canary.
dana: mitigation checklist: rollback complete, alias revoked, kill-switch off for auto-rollouts, monitoring alerts raised for tokenizer-version mismatches, add gating check in deployment pipeline.
elaine: assigning owners: raj -> root cause audit and fix weight upload workflow; taylor -> gating check and CI; dana -> post-incident monitoring rules; support-team -> customer comms and follow-ups.
elaine: timeline note for postmortem: ```- 2361234500: hotpatch uploaded under wrong alias
- 2361234520: canary routing started (auto)
- 2361234550: abnormal 500s begin
- 2361234567: pager triggered
- 2361234820: rollback initiated
- 2361234880: kill-switch flipped; rollback complete
- 2361234960: customers notified
```
taylor: quick ask - can we add a temporary probe that tests decode for a canonical prompt during canary before shifting live traffic? saves us from token mismatch slips.
raj: good idea, I'll prototype the probe and wire into pre-rollout checks.
elaine: closing actions noted. Any objections to marking incident as mitigated?
support-team: no objections.
dana: mitigated but postmortem required.
elaine: marking mitigated at 2361235150. Will follow up with postmortem draft and remedial tickets. :white_check_mark:
